evidence.quote: Most of our REST endpoints and GraphQL Admin API endpoints use the X-Auth-Token header to authenticate to BigCommerce servers.
BigCommerce no longer issues legacy API Accounts to new stores.
Sign up for a free BigCommerce trial store to test API calls and build integrations without affecting live data.
REST Management API, REST Storefront API, GraphQL Storefront API
The BigCommerce MCP server lets AI agents interact with a BigCommerce storefront using purpose-built commerce tools.

result.notes: Free trial store gives immediate self-serve OAuth credentials (client_id/secret/access_token via X-Auth-Token) for both REST Management API and GraphQL Admin/Storefront APIs. Legacy basic-auth API accounts are deprecated (no longer issued to new stores), so 'basic' was excluded. JWT auth applies to Customer Login/Current Customer and GraphQL Storefront/Payments APIs. Official MCP server is storefront-shopping-focused (search/cart/checkout), not full admin API coverage, but it exists and is vendor-published.
result.one_liner: BigCommerce is an ecommerce platform offering REST and GraphQL APIs for store/catalog/order management and storefront/checkout operations.
